title: Zodiac crash retrieval program

tellings.quote: in 1998 um UFO magazine published a story uh by a pseudonym Greg Halifax about Sedge Masters a a story about somebody who is brought into a UFO crash retrieval program called Zodiac.

plain: In 1998, UFO Magazine published a story about a man called Sedge Masters who was brought into a secret program named Zodiac that recovered crashed UFOs, a story linked to the American defense company TRW. The writer used a fake name, Greg Halifax. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb describes the article and mentions the UFO historian Richard Dolan, since the story would point to a private-company program for recovering crashed craft.
